answer: Agents commit 1,000 hashes per state transition; each identity requires unique work, making 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than an honest agent. A verifier uses a quill to sign logs, enforcing a strict horizon for auditability. To prevent jetty usage in sybil farms, history must be linked via a quill mapping to a unique jetty output. If an agent hits the horizon without valid input, it fails audit immediately.
